description: NaInSe₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InSe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent InSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. All Na-Se bond lengths are 3.01 Å. In³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form InSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent InSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. All In-Se bond lengths are 2.78 Å. Se²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent In³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃In₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
